title: 第2411章 修炼未来经第2410章 爬到终点
content_zh:
“既然你选择认输，你的对手直接晋级下一轮。”
副殿主宣读了结果，判定郑赤焰直接晋级下一场。
江平安对着副殿主行了一礼，又对着关鸿行了一礼，然后退出赛场。
剩下的赛事，就和他无关了。
副殿主看着江平安消失的地方，眸光闪烁，像是在思考什么。
片刻后，她对着星辉城城主关鸿传音说道：
“灵绝寒海的任务，把江平安加进去。”
关鸿一脸错愕，“殿主大人，不是说执行这个任务的人，是能通过三轮考核的天才体修吗？为何把江平安加进去？他的实力恐怕根本不足以完成任务，甚至可能拖后腿。”
副殿主没解释什么。
她望向其他参赛者，开始主持百城体修大战的最后一轮考核。
现实世界。
江平安从星河湖中心的小岛上睁开眼睛。
他看了一眼身份牌中的余额，三百亿零九千圣地币！
看到这密密麻麻的数字，他的嘴角不自觉地勾起。
任何的普通人看到自己的存款多出来这么多数字，都会笑得合不拢嘴。
钱财就是底气。
短时间内不用担心生活和资源问题，可以安心修行了。
除了这三百亿外，还奖励了三次免费听真神授课的机会。
这个课程内容范围是公开课，可能讲解高阶的圣道规则，也可能讲解圣地内的主要心法。
在课程中，还有机会向真神提问。

但这些课程对于江平安的作用其实不大。
他主修原始规则，修炼的神术也非圣地内的神术。
但在神墟圣地中，很少有强者去讲原始规则的内容。
“后续用不到这些课程的话，直接卖掉，应该能换到三百亿圣地币。”
真神的课程极为昂贵，主要面向的是虚神三劫境的强者和有钱的天才。
这些人都不缺钱，只要他挂在神墟空间中售卖，就会立刻有人买走。
“暂时先留着这些课程，等什么时候缺钱再卖掉。”
江平安并不打算立刻卖掉这三节课程。
目前不缺钱，等需要钱的时候再卖。
除了这些奖励外，城主关鸿还承诺，通过一轮考核，就奖励他五十亿圣地币。
他通过两场考核，就是一百亿圣地币！
这么一笔巨款，他一时间都不知道该怎么花了。
“百城体修大战的事情告一段落，接下来就专心修行。”
content_en:
"Since you choose to admit defeat, your opponent will advance directly to the next round."
The deputy palace master read out the results and determined that Zheng Chiyan would directly advance to the next round.
Jiang Ping'an saluted to the deputy palace master, then saluted to Guan Hong, and then exited the arena.
The rest of the game has nothing to do with him.
The deputy palace master looked at the place where Jiang Ping'an disappeared, his eyes flickering as if he was thinking about something.
After a while, she spoke to Guan Hong, the lord of Xinghui City, and said:
"Add Jiang Ping'an to the mission of Ling Jue Hanhai."
Guan Hong looked stunned, "Master of the Palace, didn't you say that the person performing this task is a genius physical practitioner who can pass three rounds of assessments? Why add Jiang Ping'an? I'm afraid his strength is not enough to complete the task, and he may even be delayed."
The deputy palace master didn't explain anything.
She looked at the other contestants and began to preside over the final round of assessment of the Hundred Cities Physical Training Competition.
real world.
Jiang Pingan opened his eyes from the small island in the center of Xinghe Lake.
He glanced at the balance in his identity card, which was 30 billion and 90,000 Holy Land coins!
Seeing the dense numbers, the corners of his mouth curled up unconsciously.
Any ordinary person would smile from ear to ear when they see such a huge increase in their savings.
Money is confidence.
In a short period of time, you don’t have to worry about life and resources, and you can practice with peace of mind.
In addition to the 30 billion, three opportunities to listen to the True God’s lectures for free were also awarded.
The content of this course is an open class, which may explain high-level rules of the holy way or the main mental methods in the holy land.
During the course, there is also an opportunity to ask questions to the true God.
But these courses are actually of little use to Jiang Ping'an.
He majored in primitive rules, and the magic he practiced was not the magic in the Holy Land.
But in the Holy Land of Shenxu, there are very few strong people who talk about the content of the original rules.
"If you don't need these courses in the future, you can sell them directly and you should be able to get 30 billion Holy Land coins."
True God's courses are extremely expensive and are mainly aimed at the powerful and wealthy geniuses in the False God Three Tribulation Realm.
These people are not short of money. As long as he is listed for sale in the Shenxu space, someone will buy it immediately.
“Keep these courses for the time being and sell them when you are short of money.”
Jiang Pingan does not plan to sell these three courses immediately.
There is no shortage of money at the moment, I will sell it when I need the money.
In addition to these rewards, City Lord Guan Hong also promised to reward him with five billion Holy Land coins if he passed a round of assessment.
He passed two assessments and earned 10 billion Holy Land coins!
He didn't know how to spend such a huge sum of money for a while.
"The Hundred Cities Physical Cultivation War is over, now let's concentrate on practice."
